posts.title: be quiet
posts.description: For individuals There are three versions of this suggestion: strategic silence, listening, and stillness. Strategic silence is actively making a decision not to talk about something. In the context of computer use conversations, and headlines about technology, this is a way to maintain narrative focus and attention and to disregard distractions.
